messages:
sam: Hey payroll team — my YTD state withholding looks off on the W-2 preview. I relocated from NY to MA on 2026-05-10 and updated my address, but paystubs for May/Jun show NY state tax still. Did payroll use the old state code?
hr_payroll: Hi @sam — can you DM a screenshot of the W-2 preview and confirm the date you updated your work address in Workday? We'll escalate.
sam: DM'ed the screenshot and the address change timestamp (2026-05-11). Thanks.
payroll-bot: Payroll batch #202606 processed for 2026-06-30; state files submitted.
payroll_ops: Thanks @sam. We see the address change came after the April payroll cut-off but before May. However the HR->payroll sync failed for the May run and defaulted to prior NY setting. We'll pull the May/Jun runs and calculate reclassification if needed.
finance_ops: Heads up — if wages need reclassification between NY/MA we may need to adjust state filings or file amended returns depending on the amounts and timing. Please collect affected pay dates and gross wages.
jess-legal: Note: keep proof of move (lease, utility, travel) on file to support reallocation in case of state review. Also check MA reciprocity rules (none for NY), so reallocation is straightforward.
sam: I have lease + utilities uploaded to the secure bucket.
hr_payroll: Plan: 1) Payroll Ops will identify affected pay periods and compute YTD reallocation 2) Finance will advise on whether to amend NY withholding returns or offset on upcoming filings 3) If employee tax liability changes, we'll provide documentation and issue refunds in payroll or via one-time adjustment. Expect update in 3 business days.
payroll-bot: Ticket #PAY-2026-88 created: "Midyear state withholding reclassification — Sam" (linked to thread 1785009999). Sensitive docs stored in People Ops secure bucket.
payroll_ops: Action items assigned. We'll post calculations and proposed adjustments on this thread once complete.
sam: Appreciate the quick response — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
